title: A receipt you tear off
summary: Drag the receipt away slowly for a clean tear, or fast for a jagged edge.

prompts.text: Make a web page on a plain light grey stage, with a thin black pill-shaped slot just wider than a white thermal receipt. Give the receipt black monospace text, neat columns for item prices and totals, a small barcode near the bottom and a fine zigzag bottom edge. No Nike or Apple marks, phone interface or floating instructions. Start with the already-printed receipt hidden behind the slot and slide the whole sheet down through it, bottom end first: the first visible line and the barcode move down with the paper, ending farthest from the slot. Never feed a blank sheet or add text line by line. Stop with the entire receipt hanging from the slot. A slow drag down with a mouse or finger tears the top straight along the slot; a fast pull tears it jagged. Let the detached paper swing away so I can see the torn edge. Keep a Reprint button centred below the fully fed paper, with a clear gap so it never covers the zigzag edge even on a phone, and make it feed the next receipt the same way. Build it with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a new folder inside the current project folder, open it in my browser when it is done, check in a browser that the feed and both tears work, and ask me before installing or loading anything.
prompts.label: A receipt that tears clean or jagged

action.label: Make a receipt you can tear
